title: Rattle Family Business
description: Rattle Family Business — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Eliminate Sissirat and his guard Rattle Toe. They are in Sissirat's Lair off of Level 7 of Algernon. Report your progress to the Townston Commander in Townston when done.

Quest Reward: Gold and 10 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Eliminate Sissirat and his guard Rattle Toe. They are in Sissirat's Lair off of Level 7 of Algernon. Report your progress to the Townston Commander in Townston when done.

Offer:

Oh hey there Dungeon Runner. How's the day been? That's good. Mine's been fine so far, thanks for asking. So what brings you here? Visits are nice and all but I am quite busy. Oh, I called for you? Oh right!! That thing....

Sissirat's FizzStar Fizzing FizzDrink is so popular that Townston's energy drink business is devastated. No one is drinking Red Karl anymore, not even mixed with potato juice. Sure, ever since the Kingdom enacted Dissallowance no one is drinking FizzStar out in the streets, but you can tell. People have that green gleam in their eye and shake in their step: they're packed with energy! Sissirat's energy! It must be served in those Squeakeasys.

We've tried the indirect route, so let's do something a bit louder. I need you to put the moves on Sissirat: stabby moves. With your sword. While you are there, take out his bodyguard Rattle Toe. The Rattle Family sent him to protect Sissirat and he is quite good. He's up for another Blademaster of the Year award, I hear. He probably also has a hit taken out on you like the rest of his family, so removing him is a win-win situation!

So you will do this for us? Great! Do you think you will win? Oh don't worry why I'm asking. Just head down to Sissirat's Lair off of Level 7 of Algernon and take them out. When you finish, come back to see me, the Townston Commander.

Turn-in:

Good work Dungeon Runner! I knew I could count on you and the thirty-to-one odds listed for you! We've had to turn to... alternate revenue streams lately. As an added bonus it looks like you might have delayed the FizzStar Fizzing FizzDrink operations, at least temporarily. Now you are sure that Sissirat is dead right? I'm not going to start getting reports that he is alive and well am I?

Well let's hope not. Anyway, here is your cut from the stakes. You are turning into quite the profitable venture.

Objectives:

  • Eliminate Sissirat
  • Eliminate Rattle Toe

Level range: 10–20
